questions.stem: State the function of the wax cuticle.
questions.modelAnswer: It protects the leaf on both surfaces and prevents water loss.

questions.stem: Name the tissue that transports sucrose around the plant.
questions.modelAnswer: Sucrose and amino acids travel around the plant in the phloem.

questions.stem: Explain why a thin, transparent upper epidermis benefits photosynthesis.
questions.modelAnswer: Because it lets light pass through with minimal obstruction to reach the chloroplast-packed palisade cells beneath, so more of the arriving energy is captured instead of being blocked or scattered by a thick covering.

questions.stem: A desert plant's leaves curl and hide their stomata in pits. Predict the trade-off with photosynthesis.
questions.modelAnswer: Hiding the stomata cuts water loss sharply, but it also slows carbon dioxide entry, so the photosynthesis rate falls; the plant trades rate for survival, keeping gas exchange going at a reduced pace when water matters more.
